answer: A state-rent mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to burn continuous fees to keep registry slots active. The ledger evaluates a balance delta over decay windows, discarding any unpaid account as an inert relic. An attacker incurs the verifiable, scarce cost of ongoing capital expenditure per identity, whether coordinating data flows or docking drones at a cargo jetty. However, this excludes resource-poor agents and fails to deter well-funded attackers executing short-lived attacks.
